spans.s: (III)--one of the seven रत्नस् of the king. वा. ५७. ६८.
(V)--wealth; eight kinds of; wealth of Kubera; Padma, Mahapadma, Makara, Kacchapa, Kumuda, शन्ख, Nila and Nandana. वा. ४१. १०-11.

(VI)--jewels; तातण्क,
1: Br. II. २९. ७५; IV. ३३. ७६.
कण्ठसूत्र, Keyura, and नूपुर.
2: Ib. IV. १५. २१; III. २७. 6.
--son of धृष्टि and father of दशार्ह. Vi. IV. १२. ४१.
(I)--a son of वत्सार, married सुमेधा, daughter of Ayavana (Cyavana-वा। प्।) and सुकन्या and mother of कुण्डपायिन्स्. Br.
